notes.title: Patch 30/05-2025 (2)
notes.content:
A patch has been released to Celldom Classic
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with progress not properly being saved.
[/list]

Terribly sorry about this issue, this was a huge oversight on my part. If you were affected by this issue then please contact me through Discord and I will have a savefile restored for you
